description: Livelli di rumorosità delle strade exstraurbane is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. Estensione della rete stradale a valenza regionale e provinciale che presenta livelli compresi in prefissati intervalli di rumorosità. Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are regional, reti-di-trasporto. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
